messages:
anya: Heads-up — uploading weights for llama3-small v2.3 to gs://rwd-models/llama3/weights/v2.3. Marking as `onboard-ready`. Need a quick sign-off on tokenizer mapping & chat template before we flip.

sam: Thanks — are we using the old sentinel mapping or the new chatfmt special tokens?

anya: Using chatfmt. Special tokens are: <|system|>, <|user|>, <|assistant|>. Tokenizer map uploaded at `gs://rwd-models/llama3/weights/v2.3/token_map.json`. Note: saw a duplicate EOS when running cached responses with empty system messages (repro locally).

mj: Can you paste the tokenizer config snippet? quick grep would help.

anya: Snippet from the config we packed into the wheel: ```json
{
  "special_tokens": {
    "bos_token":"<|bos|>",
    "eos_token":"<|eos|>",
    "sep_token":"<|sep|>",
    "system_token":"<|system|>"
  },
  "trim_whitespace": true,
  "pad_side":"right"
}
```

leo: FYI eng-ci-bot ran the model-verify job after the upload: checksum OK, but `tokenizer-check` FAILED — duplicate `eos_token` observed when the first chat turn is an empty system. Log excerpt: ```
[WARN] encode_sequence: appended eos (idx 502)
[WARN] encode_sequence: appended eos (idx 502)  <-- duplicate
[DEBUG] input roles: [system:'', user:'hello']
```

anya: Repro steps I used: create chat template `[{role: "system", content: ""}, {role: "user", content: "hello"}]` then run `tokenizer.encode_chat(template)`. Output had two trailing eos tokens. I think `encode_chat` treats empty system as sentinel then also appends eos in the per-message loop.

sam: Two quick mitigation options: 1) strip empty-system messages in preprocessor, 2) make tokenizer append eos only when the role/message encoding doesn't already end with eos. Which is lower-risk for canary?

anya: I lean to (1) for short-term (no kernel changes), add a preprocessor rule: `if role == 'system' and content.strip() == '': drop it`. Add unit test and smoke in canary. For medium-term, add defensiveness in tokenizer as (2).

mj: Also remember to update `weights.json` metadata on the bucket: add "tokenizer_version": "3" and "chat_template": "chatfmt-v2". If missing the runtime will fallback to legacy behavior and might mask the fix.

eng-ci-bot: Build triggered for PR #342 (tokenizer-empty-system-fix). Tests: 120 total, tokenizer unit tests (15) — 1 failing (eos-dup).

leo: Quick review notes — small lint nit, otherwise OK. Recommend merge after CI green. Plan canary to `dedicated-prev` in `eu-west-1` with traffic=5% then monitor `tokenizer-check` and `prefix_eos_rate` metric.

anya: I'll open the PR in ~30m and tag @leo @sam for review. I'll add manual smoke steps in the PR: 1) push sample chat with empty system 2) assert single eos, 3) run perf smoke. :eyes:

sam: Thanks — ping me once deployed to canary, I'll run a quick corpus sweep for edge templates.

mj: Adding a follow-up task for docs: update `onboarding.md` to include the `tokenizer_version` field and the recommended `chatfmt-v2` template examples.

anya: +1. Closing loop here — will post the PR link in this thread when ready.
